title: 道路用減速クッション
description: 傾斜した進入面、モジュール継ぎ目、アンカー、滑り止め、黄色い表示を備える道路用減速パッド。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A low rubber traffic-calming pad with tapered approaches, modular seams, fixing sockets, traction ribs and yellow approach stripes. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
